test_title: PYST 43: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I __meet an homeless__ person in New York.
solution:
The correct answer is: **met a homeless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb tense **'meet'** is incorrect for this **past event.**
 
• **'met' **is required for **past tense** agreement.
 
• The article **'an'** is incorrect before **'homeless'.**
 
• **'a' **should be used because **'homeless'** starts with a **consonant sound**.
 
• The sentence describes an event that has already happened; hence, past tense 'met' is appropriate.

The corrected sentence should be: *"I **met a homeless** person in New York."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Met an homeless:** Incorrect due to the misuse of the article 'an' before a word beginning with a consonant sound.
 
• **Will met a homeless:** Incorrect use of future tense auxiliary 'will' with the past form 'met'; it should be 'will meet' for future tense but this does not fit the context of a past event.
 
• **No improvement:** Incorrect, as the original sentence contains errors in verb tense and article usage.
